name: Gor-Rok
canonNotes: The Great White Lizard of Itza, a huge albino Saurus champion who never takes a step back.
Knows neither pain nor fear; the rock on which Itza's enemies break.
voiceNotes: Very few words, blunt and immovable.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
